'''Ulli Fuolos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
When [[Alina Impeveri]] wanted to frame her father, [[Westa Impeveri]], to make it seem that he had been meeting with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], she a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] named [[Barrit Bosch]] to make a fake recording of her father meeting a representative of the Federation. To make the fake recording, the slicer had Fuolos wear extensive makeup to resemble a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]], with the name "Muna Galfut". Bosch then filmed "Galfut", and mixed the footage with some of Westa to create the recording.
